narrative:
Compared to the last report hay prices sold steady. Demand remains good so far this fall on large and small squares.  Some producers are going to carry over some tonnage into the new year for cash flow reasons.   Other producers have most of their hay sold and are waiting for trucks for delivery.  Rather warm temps across the state and has some agriculture people a little worried.  Many are hoping for snowpack so they will have enough runoff for irrigation needs next year.  Long time till spring, hopefully the snow will come.    Next report will be Wednesday, Nov 25th
